old_caption: The video showcases a close-up view of one large, faceted gemstone, likely a diamond or similar precious stone, resting against a stark black background. The stone is predominantly clear and transparent, displaying a spectrum of colors including blue and purple due to its refraction properties. It remains stationary throughout, with light reflecting off its facets and creating a bright, sparkling effect. The camera remains steady, capturing the intricate details and the play of light on the surface of the stone. The background remains consistently dark, ensuring that all attention is drawn to the vibrant colors and sparkling facets of the gemstone. The video emphasizes the beauty and complexity of this precious stone through the interplay of light and shadow.
original_wisa_caption: The video showcases a close-up view of two large, faceted gemstones, likely diamonds or similar precious stones, rotating against a stark black background. The first stone is predominantly yellow with hints of green, reflecting light in a way that highlights its facets and brilliance. As it rotates, the second stone, which is clear and transparent, comes into focus. This stone also displays a spectrum of colors, including blue and purple, due to its refraction properties. The camera remains steady throughout, capturing the intricate details and the play of light on the surfaces of the stones. The background remains consistently dark, ensuring that all attention is drawn to the vibrant colors and sparkling facets of the gemstones. The video emphasizes the beauty and complexity of these precious stones through their continuous rotation and the interplay of light and shadow.
caption: The video showcases a single large faceted transparent gemstone, cut in a pear or marquise shape, resting on a glossy black mirror surface that casts a crisp inverted reflection beneath it against a pure black backdrop scattered with tiny light specks. The stone's silhouette, orientation, and position remain essentially fixed throughout the excerpt, so the visible motion is confined to light playing across its surface. A bright starburst specular flare travels along the top edge of the gem, starting at the upper-right tip and gradually relocating to the upper-center-left ridge. There it swells into a taller, brighter vertical streak. As this highlight moves, the colored facet bands inside the crystal shift through blues, violets, and whites, changing position and intensity. These shimmering internal reflections are mirrored in the inverted image below, which brightens and dims in tandem. A handful of small white points in the dark background flicker and drift subtly in brightness.

not ground truth. Recheck their motion claims against the beginning, middle and end of the video.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
Return JSON {"caption":"complete revised caption",
